mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals immediate monetary easing that lowers discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 2-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% and remains elevated for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a broad-based contraction in the real economy, which triggers a risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and INDPRO decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02 over 5-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime characterized by strong consumer spending, a sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) above 0.5% month-over-month signals robust demand that supports corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods during late-cycle expansion when RSAFS growth exceeds 0.5% m/m, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 150,000 per month indicates a strong labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 150,000, or the Rank IC over 5-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the core CPI (CPIAUCSL) rises above 2.5% year-over-year, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger a monetary policy tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tightening monetary policy in a strong labor market, which increases the cost of capital and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening in strong labor market
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained regime, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (index) indicates a contraction in manufacturing output that disrupts supply chains and reduces corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during supply-constrained regimes when INDPRO falls below 100, or the Rank IC over 5-year windows is below 0.02.
